sections.text_helper: Section 27.5 "AHB interface" in chapter 27 (Flexible memory controller (FMC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1179.
sections.section_content:
The AHB slave interface allows internal CPUs to configure the FMC registers.
The AHB clock (HCLK) is the reference clock for the FMC register accesses.
The FMC registers must be accessed by words (32 bits). For non 32-bit AHB accesses,
FMC does not return an AHB bus error and the register value can be corrupted.
